question: Which of the following is not included in the list of official languages under the Ladakh Official Languages Regulation 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Tamil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• President Murmu promulgates Ladakh Official Languages Regulation 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**President Droupadi Murmu** promulgated the **Ladakh Official Languages Regulation 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
It applies to the **entire Union Territory of Ladakh**.

 
 
• 
 
The regulation was notified by the **Ministry of Law and Justice**.

 
 
• 
 
Recognised official languages are: **English, Hindi, Urdu, Bhoti, and Purgi**.

 
 
• 
 
**English** was already used for official work **before this regulation**.
